_provenance: grand_mean/total_sd/icc from data/seeds/norms.json (cited); between/within SD derived.

work_engagement__psych_safety.source_title: Psychological Safety: A Meta-Analytic Review and Extension
work_engagement__psych_safety.evidence_quote: Frazier et al. (2017) include work engagement in the psychological-safety nomological net and characterize it as a strong outcome of psychological safety; the located affective-outcome cluster reports rho = .48 (commitment) and rho = .53 (satisfaction). The exact PS-engagement table cell could not be isolated from the open-access secondary sources.
work_engagement__psych_safety.prior_rationale: Meta-analysis (Frazier 2017) is located and DOI-verified and DOES report a PS x work-engagement relationship described as strong; the precise table cell was not extractable from open-access copies (primary PDF bot-blocked), so 0.50 is an expert prior anchored to Frazier's documented affective-outcome cluster (.48-.53) with a wide margin.
work_engagement__psych_safety.fulltext_note: Frazier 2017 Table2 Engagement row L857: obs r=.36, rho=.45 (full-text verified, supersedes abstract_only)
work_engagement__psych_safety.resolution_note: 2026-06-22: replaced 0.50 expert prior with the full-text-verified Frazier 2017 Table 2 Engagement-row corrected rho=0.45 (already recorded as rho_corrected_fulltext); is_expert_prior set False, margin tightened to 0.10.

work_engagement__work_creativity.source_title: Work Engagement and Innovative Work Behavior: Meta-Analysis Study
work_engagement__work_creativity.source_journal: Advances in Social Science, Education and Humanities Research (ICPSYCHE 2020)
work_engagement__work_creativity.evidence_quote: Work Engagement and Innovative Work Behavior have a medium effect size correlation (r = 0.46 with 95% CI between 0.423-0.506). [k = 26 correlations]

work_engagement__team_trust.evidence_quote: No dedicated between-person meta-analysis reporting a single work-engagement x trust correlation was located. Primary studies and reviews consistently report a positive, moderate-to-strong association (organizational/vertical trust is a documented engagement antecedent); adjacent meta-analytic anchors (Frazier 2017 PS-trust rho=.45; engagement affective-correlate cluster .48-.63) bracket this region.
work_engagement__team_trust.prior_rationale: No direct meta-analytic r exists for work engagement x team/organizational trust. Expert prior of 0.45 set in the moderate-to-strong positive range that primary studies and adjacent meta-analyses (PS-trust .45; engagement-with-affective-correlates .48-.63) imply, with a wide margin to reflect the absence of a direct source.

psych_safety__work_creativity.source_title: Psychological Safety: A Meta-Analytic Review and Extension
psych_safety__work_creativity.evidence_quote: psychological safety demonstrated a positive and significant relationship with information sharing (rho = .52), citizenship behaviors (rho = .32), creativity (rho = .13), and learning behavior (rho = .62). [Frazier 2017, via open-access secondary summary]
psych_safety__work_creativity.value_note: Frazier's reported PS-creativity rho = .13 is unusually low relative to the team-level innovation literature (e.g., Hulsheger, Anderson & Salgado 2009, DOI 10.1037/a0015978, reports support-for-innovation rho between .4 and .5 with creativity/innovation). The wide margin reflects this construct/level heterogeneity. Hulsheger et al. 2009 is an alternative team-level anchor if a higher value is preferred for L3.

psych_safety__team_trust.source_title: Psychological Safety: A Meta-Analytic Review and Extension
psych_safety__team_trust.evidence_quote: Trust as an antecedent of psychological safety: '.39, .54, .45 | D, D, B | Aamir, 2013; Basit, 2017; Frazier, 2017' -- the B-graded value .45 is the Frazier (2017) meta-analytic estimate (CIPD open-access evidence review 'Trust and psychological safety', 2024, Table 3 antecedents).
psych_safety__team_trust.fulltext_note: Frazier 2017 Table2 Trust-in-leadership L849: obs r=.32, rho=.39; trust-in-leader != team trust (loose)

work_creativity__team_trust.source_title: The relationship between trust and creativity in organizations: Evidence from meta-analysis
work_creativity__team_trust.evidence_quote: Meta-analysis results: lateral (horizontal) trust (r = 0.50), vertical trust (r = 0.38), and system trust (r = 0.48) are significantly positively correlated with creativity. [85 studies, 99 independent effect sizes; lateral-trust k = 41]. Team/intrateam trust maps to lateral (horizontal) trust, r = 0.50.

_cross_state_provenance.description: Between-person meta-analytic correlations among the four workplace psychological states (work_engagement WE, psych_safety PS, work_creativity WC, team_trust TT). Used to validate that synthetic populations reproduce the empirically documented cross-state nomological net. This file supersedes the prior all-unsourced placeholder version (archived in git history); cross_state.between has now been sourced via Stream A (OpenAlex + Unpaywall).
_cross_state_provenance.pair_key_convention: two state keys joined by '__', ordering matches the prior cross_state.between keys (and the task spec example): work_engagement, psych_safety, work_creativity, team_trust precedence.
_cross_state_provenance.method: OpenAlex works API located each meta-analysis; every DOI was verified to resolve via its OpenAlex record. Where an open-access full text or an open-access secondary evidence review existed, the focal between-person r was confirmed and quoted (see evidence_quote). Sources located 2026-06-20.

status_legend.verified: focal between-person r extracted and quoted from the located open-access full text of the meta-analysis itself
status_legend.abstract_only: meta-analysis located and DOI verified; focal r confirmed from the abstract or from an open-access secondary evidence review that tabulates the meta-analytic value, but not extracted from the primary full-text table (primary PDF paywalled/bot-blocked)
status_legend.no_meta_found: no direct between-person meta-analytic correlation located for this pair; r is a documented EXPERT PRIOR, not a measured estimate (is_expert_prior=true, see prior_rationale)

_cross_state_provenance.honesty_note: Every r with is_expert_prior=false traces to a real, DOI-verified located source. Pairs with is_expert_prior=true carry a point value clearly labeled as a prior with a WIDE margin; they are NOT measured meta-analytic estimates. All values are between-person estimates (the usual meta-analytic criterion).
